page.layout: Running text on one printed page: page header (running head) at top; main text in full-width paragraphs (two paragraphs); below them a large diagram-like synopsis of deaneries and parishes in several columns with brace and bracket groupings; marginal notes on left and right edges (side notes such as "In Ciuitate", "In Diocesi" and the Dean names as brackets). Page number "32" at top left. Bottom: "Hi" signature-like mark at lower right.

main_text.p: Tandem eiecta prorsus authoritate papali, cum Henricus octauus, vt diximus, iuris Ecclesiastici moderationem & æquitatem lege lata in Cantuariensi Archiepiscopo potuisset, constituta noua curia est, eiusque iudex præfectus, qui desideria cognoscit eorum, qui iuris quandoq; rigidi atq; stricti relaxationem petunt, & Registrarius qui concessas dispensationes in scriptaretert. Ille Magister seu custos facultatum, hic earum Registrarius appellatur. Hæc curia quia litigiola non est, in ædibus Archiepiscopi sine foro & tribunali plerumq; excercetur.

Habet etiam Archiepiscopus Cant. in nonnullis Prouinciæ suæ Dioecesibus Parochias quasdam à iurisdictione Episcopali & Archidiaconali quacunq; separatas, sibiq; peculiares. Quibus peculiares præsunt iudices, qui peculiarium Decani appellantur, quibus etiam peculiares atq; proprij Registrarii adiunguntur. Hæ autem Parochiæ ordine secundùm diocæses scripiæ sequuntur:
main_text.l: Ecclesia sancti Michaelis in Corneill Lane.
Ecclesia sancti Michaelis in Riola, alias Pater noster.
Eccl. S. Iohan. Euangelistæ in Maslonstreet.
Ecclesia de Shorhá cū Capella de Offord.

page.notes: The right-hand part of the page is a diagram of deaneries (Decanatus de Bocking, Decanatus de Rysbergh, Decanatus de Pagham, Decanatus de Terring, Decanatus de Sowthwalling) with parish lists and brackets in the right column; the left column of the diagram is set in smaller type and is only partly legible. Diocese labels such as "In Ciuitate London", "In Diocesi Roffen", "In Diocesi Winton", "In Diocesi London", "In Diocesi Norwich", "In Diocesi Lincoln", "In Diocesi Oxon", "In Diocesi Cicestren" appear as side labels. The bottom line reads "Hi" at lower right. Several entries in the dense diagram are uncertain and may contain errors.
